description: We are a team of Computer Science students specializing in Artificial Intelligence, passionate about solving real-world problems through technology. For NASA Space Apps 2026, we aim to combine AI, machine learning, and NASA Earth observation data to create an innovative and interactive solution. We enjoy exploring new ideas, building creative projects, and working together. We welcome passionate teammates with skills in data science, design, animation, and development.
